ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES  
Administration & Office Support 
Answer telephone calls, respond to emails, and manage general enquiries in a professional and 
culturally respectful manner. 
 
Perform general administrative duties including scanning, photocopying, filing, and document 
management.  

Maintain accurate client records, databases, and filing systems in accordance with organisational 
policies and privacy requirements
.  
Assist with data entry, reporting, and documentation for CHSP, HCP, NDIS, and other funded 
programs.  

Support roster updates, staff schedule changes, and communication of roster amendments. 
 
Administration Support Officer - Mala’la Aged Care 
 
Client Transport & Appointment Coordination 

Coordinate daily transport schedules including pick-up and drop-off arrangements for Social 
Support at Home (S@H), CHSP, NDIS, and Day Respite clients.  

Work closely with visiting health services, including Mala’la Clinic, Patient Travel, and Chronic 
Conditions teams to support client attendance at medical appointments.  

Liaise with clients, families, support workers, and service providers regarding transport and 
appointment schedules. 
 
Client Support Assistance 
Assist clients with Centrelink residency enquiries, banking enquiries, and access to community 
services.  
Support clients with activating SIM cards, mobile phone setup, and communication with family 
members when required.  
Provide culturally appropriate support to clients in accessing information and services.  
Assist clients in a respectful and confidential manner while maintaining professional boundaries. 
 
Operational Support 
Provide assistance to Support Workers on the floor when required, including:  
Assisting with meal distribution  
Supporting client activities and group programs  
Assisting during busy operational periods
